license.scope: The two adapted code helpers; publication content rights are separate.

siteChanges: CommonJS exports and explicit source/output roots replace repository-specific defaults.
Synchronous bounded source reading rejects traversal, symbolic links and hardlinks.
Output checks support regular files and generation directories, protected-path overlap and aliases.
Directory transactions replace the upstream single-file atomic writer, retain backups until byte and inventory verification, and report preserved recovery paths on rollback failure.
CommonJS and bounded synchronous Git calls use the caller's explicit repository root and disable Git replacement objects.
The declaration pins SHA256 bytes and either two null Git identities or an exact commit and blob pair.
Null identities are explicitly working-tree-review; frozen editions verify regular tree mode, the committed blob and exact committed bytes.
Historical committed pins can be verified directly from Git objects after the working manuscript moves to a new edition.
Dirty previews require an explicit option and retain the actual working blob identity; neither SHA256 nor the declared committed blob can be bypassed.

exclusions: tools/publishing/history.cjs is a new site implementation, not an upstream extraction.
No Quartz application, runtime, dependency tree, publication renderer, research registry or upstream doctrine is copied by this extraction.
Article manuscripts, figures, metadata and edition permissions retain their own provenance and rights.
